complaint: IndiGo ne meri Delhi–Bangalore flight cancel kar di, bas SMS aaya. Refund maanga to credit shell de diya, bolte hain refund nahi milega. Ticket ₹8,800 ka tha.
complaint_en: IndiGo cancelled my Delhi–Bangalore flight, I only received an SMS. When I asked for a refund, they gave me a credit shell and said a refund would not be provided. The ticket cost ₹8,800.
legal_query: airline flight cancellation refund policy DGCA consumer protection act
